name: CenterPoint Energy
description: CenterPoint Energy is a regulated energy delivery holding company with two reportable segments. Electric is Houston Electric (wires-only transmission and distribution in the Houston area, which grows with the region's load) plus Indiana Electric (SIGECO, a vertically integrated utility with 1,228 MW of coal, gas and solar generation). Natural Gas is a large regulated gas distribution business serving over four million customers across several states, now being slimmed down: it sold its Louisiana and Mississippi gas utilities and agreed in October 2025 to sell its Ohio gas utility for $2.62 billion. It earns a regulated return on rate base; earnings rise with the rate base it adds, with Houston electricity load growth as the stated driver.

gics.note: Conventional filing label: GICS Sector 'Utilities', Sub-Industry 'Multi-Utilities' per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30); that list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 4911 (Electric Services) per EDGAR.

employees.note: Electric 3,516, Natural Gas 3,259, Corporate and Other 2,019; 3,712 under collective bargaining (FY2025 10-K employee table)

businessLines.name: Electric
businessLines.how: Retail electricity providers and customers pay PUCT- and IURC-approved delivery rates (Houston Electric earns only on delivery, not generation) and Indiana customers pay bundled rates; return on rate base and riders drive profit.
businessLines.description: Houston Electric (transmission and distribution in the Houston area) and Indiana Electric (SIGECO: generation, transmission and distribution in southwestern Indiana).

operatingProfit.note: Net income available to common shareholders by segment (FY2024 $671M, FY2023 $654M)

businessLines.name: Natural Gas
businessLines.how: Regulated monthly delivery charges set by state commissions in several states, with gas cost passed through; asset management agreements pay a fee for managing storage and pipeline capacity.
businessLines.description: Regulated natural gas distribution in Indiana, Minnesota, Ohio and Texas (customer count per the 10-K throughput table 4.03 million metered: CERC 3.91 million), asset management agreements with utilities, and, until sold, Louisiana and Mississippi LDC businesses.

operatingProfit.note: Net income available to common shareholders by segment (FY2024 $566M, FY2023 $533M); includes Louisiana and Mississippi LDC results through their sale dates

businessLines.name: Corporate & Other
businessLines.how: Not an operating business; its employees' costs are charged to the Electric and Natural Gas segments.
businessLines.description: Corporate costs and, through the date of sale, Energy Systems Group (energy performance contracting).

operatingProfit.note: Net loss available to common (FY2024 -$218M, FY2023 -$320M)

brands.name: CenterPoint Energy Houston Electric
brands.share: Largest electric business; net income share of 67% of consolidated (Electric segment)

brands.name: CenterPoint Energy Resources Corp (CERC) gas utilities
brands.share: About 3.9 million customers (CERC) of 4.0 million total for CenterPoint

brands.name: Ohio gas LDC (CEOH)
brands.note: Being sold for $2.62B, closing expected Q4 2026
